articles.summary: A business owner has finally accepted an offer. They’re excited, motivated, and ready to secure the capital they’ve been working toward. But then reality hits: a flurry of emails, scattered links, missing closing documents, and vague next steps. What should be the most confident moment in their funding journey suddenly becomes a maze and every minute of confusion increases the risk of drop-off.
articles.title: Streamlining Closing for Higher Conversions: How Checkout Transforms the Final Step of Funding

articles.summary: Partnership between Lendflow and Experian delivers a premier embedded lending experience within the Experian app, giving small business owners choice, convenience and security when applying for funding
articles.title: Experian Builds Next-Generation Lending Marketplace for Small Business Financing
